# Colour thesaurus

> A tiny SKOS vocabulary of colours.

- Ontology IRI: https://example.org/colors/scheme
- Namespace: https://example.org/colors/ (prefix `colors:`)
- License: CC0 1.0 (Public Domain)
- Contents: 4 concepts

Terms are identified by IRI; use the CURIEs and labels below when writing SPARQL or RDF.

## Documentation

- [Overview](index.md): metadata and contents
- [Concepts](concepts.md): 4 concepts with definitions and axioms

## Machine-readable

- [ontology.json](ontology.json): all terms as JSON (IRI, label, definition, hierarchy, domain/range)
- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): the complete documentation as one Markdown file
- [Turtle](ontology.ttl): the ontology source (text/turtle)
- [RDF/XML](ontology.owl): the ontology source (application/rdf+xml)
- [JSON-LD](ontology.jsonld): the ontology source (application/ld+json)
- [N-Triples](ontology.nt): the ontology source (application/n-triples)
